 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan

1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. The present application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. read with Section 482 Cr.P.C.
seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 265/2023 under Sections 498A/304B/34 IPC registered at Police Station Sarai Rohilla.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner invites the attention of the Court to the order dated 30.10.2023 passed by the learned MM-04, Central Delhi, to contend that the proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C. was initiated against the petitioner, however, vide said order the petitioner was directed to join the investigation within two days and direction was given to the I.O not to take any coercive action against the petitioner.
5.
He submits that pursuant to the aforesaid order the petitioner had This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2023 at 03:20:27 joined investigation.

However, vide order dated 03.11.2023, on the basis of the statement of the I.O to the effect that the petitioner did not cooperate in the investigation, the bail application of the petitioner was dismissed.
Further, the application filed by the petitioner seeking cancellation of process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. was also dismissed by the said order.
6. He submits that the petitioner has already joined investigation as recorded in the order dated 03.11.2023.

He further submits that the only reason on which the anticipatory bail application has Savitri Devi @ Guddi vs State Of Nct Of Delhi on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76181287/
1 been dismissed is that the petitioner did not cooperate in the investigation.
7.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that the petitioner is ready and willing to join and cooperate in the investigation.
8. Issue notice.
The learned APP for the State accepts notice.

9. Let the Status Report be filed before the next date.
10.

Taking into account the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner and having regard to the fact that the petitioner is a woman, it is directed that no coercive action be taken against the petitioner on her joining investigation on 09.11.2023 at 04:00 p.m. and subsequently as and when required by the I.O concerned.
Interim protection shall continue, till the next date.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J NOVEMBER 8, 2023/
